Practised how roots, sacred groves, neem, baoris and Chipko protect nature.
Identified Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko examples accurately.
Explained roots holding soil and neem reducing insects.
Connected baoris with storing rainwater and groundwater recharge.
Mixed up whether one person can protect nature; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
end.parentNote: Dev practised explaining how traditional practices protect soil, water, plants and animals. They used cause-and-effect explanations for roots, neem and sacred groves, and identified the Chipko example. Dev said one person may not make a difference; this mix-up was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Dev to name one small action people can take to protect a local tree or water source and explain how it helps.
